scenarios.name: anonymous: calculate shows a result, writes nothing, save requires sign-in
specialist A: double-click saves exactly once; the record reopens after a new sign-in
isolation: B sees none of A's record; admin reads it and the read is audited
saved PDF: owner gets the stored report, B gets 404, anonymous gets 401
context switch: sign-out stops A's sweep; B sees none of A's form, result or history
revocation: a blocked specialist's next save ends the session and writes nothing
error handling: a 503 on save is reported, keeps the session and is not retried
